title.value: Session-based Social Recommendation via Dynamic Graph Attention Networks
title.justification: The title 'Session-based Social Recommendation via Dynamic Graph Attention Networks' is provided at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Session-based Social Recommendation via Dynamic Graph Attention Networks

analysis.description: The paper proposes a recommendation system for online communities that dynamically models user behavior and social influence through graph-attention neural networks. It particularly focuses on session-based recommendations reflecting dynamic user interests and context-dependent social influences.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments on several real-world datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed recommendation approach, making it an empirical study.
type.quote: We conduct extensive experiments on data sets collected from several online communities (Douban, Delicious, and Yelp).

name.justification: The paper is primarily focused on improving recommendation systems in online social networks by incorporating social influences and dynamic user interests.
name.quote: We propose to study both dynamic user interests and context-dependent social influences for the recommendation in online communities.

name.justification: The paper introduces a recommendation approach utilizing dynamic graph attention networks, which model dynamic user interests and social influences.
name.quote: Our recommendation model is based on dynamic-graph-attention networks. Our approach first models user behaviors within a session using a recurrent neural network (RNN).

name.justification: The method specifically targets session-based recommendations, emphasizing the sequential and dynamic aspects of user behavior within online sessions.
name.quote: We propose a recommender system for online communities based on a dynamic-graph-attention neural network... to provide session-level recommendations.

name.justification: DGRec is explicitly mentioned as the proposed model of the paper, which integrates dynamic user interests and context-dependent social influences into recommendation systems.
name.quote: We propose a novel dynamic graph attention model Dynamic Graph Recommendation (DGRec) which models both types of preferences.

is_contributed.justification: The DGRec model is introduced as the main contribution of the paper, aiming to enhance recommendation systems in online communities.
is_contributed.quote: We propose a novel recommendation approach based on dynamic-graph-attention networks for modeling both dynamic user interests and context-dependent social influences.

is_executed.justification: The paper discusses extensive experiments conducted to evaluate the proposed DGRec model on large datasets.
is_executed.quote: We conduct extensive experiments on real-world data sets. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model.

is_compared.justification: DGRec is compared numerically against several strong and state-of-the-art baseline models, showing its superior performance.
is_compared.quote: Our proposed approach outperforms the well-known competitive baselines by modeling both users’ dynamic behaviors and dynamic social influences.

referenced_paper_title.justification: As a new contribution, DGRec does not have a reference paper title. It is a novel approach introduced in this paper.

name.justification: The Douban dataset is used for modeling social recommendations based on user behavior (movie reviews) and associated social network data.
name.quote: Douban: A popular site on which users can review movies, music, and books they consume. We crawled the data using the identities of the users in the movie community.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The paper refers to Douban as a source of its experimental data, but does not cite a specific paper for this dataset.

name.justification: The Delicious dataset is utilized for experiments on session-based recommendations of personalized tags for bookmarks.
name.quote: Delicious: An online bookmarking system where users can store, share, and discover web bookmarks.

referenced_paper_title.justification: The dataset is used in the paper but is not linked to a specific titled paper; rather, it is referenced as a source for experiments.

name.justification: Yelp's dataset is used in the experiments to assess the recommendation model effectiveness based on user reviews and social connections.
name.quote: Yelp: An online review system where users review local businesses.

referenced_paper_title.justification: Yelp dataset usage is described, but it is not cited with a specific paper reference in this study.

name.justification: TensorFlow is explicitly mentioned as the library used to implement the DGRec model as well as training graph attention networks for recommendation tasks.
name.quote: We implement our model using TensorFlow.

referenced_paper_title.value: TensorFlow: Large-Scale Machine Learning on Heterogeneous Systems
referenced_paper_title.justification: The TensorFlow library is referenced with its official documentation for further information.
referenced_paper_title.quote: Martín Abadi et al. 2015. TensorFlow: Large-Scale Machine Learning on Heterogeneous Systems. https://www.tensorflow.org/ Software available from tensorflow.org.
